releaseNotes:

- Complete removal of Seva tracking metric from UI, calculations, and database
- Updated Japa scoring logic (+25 by 9AM, +20 by 12PM, +15 by 3PM, +10 by 6PM, 0 after 6PM, -5 after 9PM/incomplete)
- Updated Pathan & Shravan scoring (+25 for >=30m, +20 for 20m, +10 for 15m, +5 for 10m, -5 for 0m)
- Solid Red Ring Indicator for zero & negative points displaying negative values
- Database migration to Room Schema Version 4
